QUOTE: Patterns come from `permissions.allow` and `permissions.deny` in config (`config/loader.cpp:365`, `types/config.h:589`). They are loaded into `PermissionManager` (`mcp/permission_manager.cpp`), which is built in `ServerManager`'s constructor at `server_manager.cpp:35`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names PermissionManager and says the lists come from config, but it never names PermissionsConfig or says ServerManager is constructed with it.
